en.headline: Finance Committee approves HK$1.6 billion to extend newborn baby bonus
en.dek: Lawmakers approved extra funding to prolong the scheme by three years and raise the second-child payment to HK$30,000, as set out in the Policy Address.
body: The Legislative Council Finance Committee on Friday approved an additional HK$1.6 billion to extend and enhance the newborn baby bonus scheme.

Under the measures announced in the Policy Address, the scheme will continue for another three years until October 2029, and the bonus for a second or subsequent child born on or after 16 September 2026 will rise from HK$20,000 to HK$30,000.

Deputy Chief Secretary Cheuk Wing-hing told the committee that the administration would review the scheme’s effectiveness after two years. The original scheme, launched in 2023, had paid bonuses to more than 77,000 applicants as of late August.

zh.headline: 財委會通過16億元額外撥款延長新生嬰兒獎勵金計劃
zh.dek: 立法會議員批准增撥款項，把計劃延長三年，並把第二名子女獎勵金提高至3萬元，落實施政報告措施。
body: 立法會財務委員會周五通過額外撥款16億元，用以延長及優化新生嬰兒獎勵金計劃。
根據施政報告公布的措施，計劃將再延長三年至2029年10月，而2026年9月16日或之後出生的第二名或更後子女的獎勵金由2萬元提高至3萬元。
政務司副司長卓永興在會上表示，當局會在兩年後檢視計劃成效。原有計劃自2023年推出以來，截至8月底已向超過7.7萬名申請者發放獎勵金。
